interest: Shows U.S. diplomats tracking Japan's early-1930s agrarian crisis—debt moratoria pleas, fertilizer subsidies, and Harbin fears of agrarian revolt.
overview: Docket (sub 14-22) for file 894.61 (1930s) covers Japanese rural depression: debt-moratorium and fertilizer-subsidy petitions, extraordinary Diet sessions, Harbin fears of agrarian revolt, Grew/Neville on agrarian law, and a hydroponics submission.

people.name: Edwin L. Neville
people.role: U.S. Chargé d'Affaires ad interim in Japan

subfiles.about: A Department of State list of papers indexing records, reports, and cross-references filed under decimal file 894.61 concerning Japanese agriculture and agrarian relief between 1930 and 1945.
subfiles.summary: Docket (Form DS-46) indexes 1930s reports on Japanese rural depression: debt-moratorium and fertilizer-subsidy petitions, extraordinary Diet sessions, Grew/Neville on agrarian law and resource restrictions, Harbin fears of agrarian revolt, and a hydroponics article.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers for File 894.61: Agriculture - Japan
